snippet.title: ルーンマスター三国英傑伝 for MSX2（Rune Master 3 / 80's Japanese old PC game）。RPG table game on the Kingdoms.
snippet.description:
EGGサービスに入っていれば【無料】三国志をテーマにしてRPG風スゴロク！　有能な士を集め、悪政に苦しむ人々を助け、太平の世をもたらす武将は誰だ？
An RPG-style table game for MSX2(Japanese old PC) released by COMPILE in 1991.
Who is the warlord who will bring peace to the world by gathering talented warriors and helping people suffering from bad government?
